title: Radiators and Inventory
author: Petra Hartwell
blurb: Astrid Brightwater, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
